rationale: Recent misses were mostly quantization micro-ablations around the current best script, so this run pivots to the highest-priority unexplored Mac-mini idea category: the remaining transferable PR #1612 small-batch MLX hyperparameters. The best script already carries the winning quantization path and softer matrix LR/momentum defaults, but it still uses the older attention sharpness and Muon warm-start settings. This patch keeps the proven int8/projection-EMA endgame intact and changes only two defaults: QK gain init from 1.5 to 4.0 and Muon momentum warmup start from 0.85 to 0.90. That compounds on the best script instead of restarting, spends the run on a new training-dynamics hypothesis, and keeps code size, artifact behavior, and final exact evaluation plumbing essentially unchanged.
title: PR1612 Hyperparameter Transfer On Best Quant Path
